bluetooth.error: Could not connect or disconnect the Bluetooth device

flyout.empty: Mark favorite devices (★) in the main window to quick-switch from here.

hotkeys.conflict: Could not register: {{list}}. Another app probably owns that shortcut.
hotkeys.mediaKeysHint: Media keys (volume, play) can be bound on their own, with no modifier — but while the app runs Windows stops receiving them.
hotkeys.gamepadHint: While the app runs, holding LB + RB on the gamepad (XInput) and pressing a button triggers its action. The game also receives those buttons — the app does not consume them.
hotkeys.gamepadNoHome: The Home button is reserved by the system and cannot be used; the modifier is LB + RB.

autoSwitch.hint: When an output device connects (a TV/monitor with audio), make it the default.

settings.title: Settings
settings.showDeviceIconHint: Second icon showing the current output (the microphone stays primary).
settings.btAutoDisconnectHint: When the default output changes, disconnects the Bluetooth device that stopped being the default (any switch path: app, hotkey, sound panel).
settings.systemAccentHint: Follows the accent colour set in Windows. Turn it off for the default blue.
settings.titleBarHint: The app-drawn bar matches the rest of the interface; the system one brings back the snap-layouts menu when you hover the maximize button.

general.logsHint: Opens the folder holding the log file, handy to attach to a bug report.
general.monitorHint: Where the mute indicator, the switch banner and the quick menu appear.

support.intro: Found a bug? Have a suggestion? Open an issue on GitHub.
support.checkUpdatesHint: Checks GitHub Releases for a newer version; the result arrives as a notification.
support.reportBugHint: Report bugs, suggest features, or ask questions about the app.

errors.list: Could not list the audio devices.

volume.label: Volume of {{name}}
volume.osdHint: Appears when you use the volume hotkeys, including over fullscreen games.
volume.slidersHint: Adds a slider to every device row.
volume.slidersInFlyout: Volume slider in the quick menu
volume.slidersInFlyoutHint: The tray menu is compact; leave this off to keep it tight.
